data.description: Drive into Ultra Luxury, Bugatti Residences, Business Bay
data.long_description:
The Sky Mansions at Bugatti Residences redefine luxury with multi-level layouts and breathtaking spatial design. These 2 to 4-bedroom residences offer expansive floor plans, private balconies, and seamless integration of living, dining, and entertainment areas.

Every residence is smartly designed to offer privacy while maximizing openness. The balance between intimate nooks and grand entertaining spaces creates a home that’s both functional and awe-inspiring.
